name: annas-mcp
description: Search Anna's Archive for books and papers and download the file you pick.
long_description: Search Anna's Archive for books, textbooks, manuals, standards and journal articles by title, author, topic or DOI, then download the copy you pick into a local folder. Filter by format, language, source or year, look up editions and ISBNs in library catalogs, check a file's identifiers and reported problems, and see how many fast downloads are left. Requires an Anna's Archive membership: the server signs in with your account's secret key and renews the session by itself. On first run the bundle downloads the matching annas-mcp release binary from GitHub, verifies its SHA-256 checksum and caches it; the signed-in session is saved in the same cache folder.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Find books, textbooks, manuals and standards by title, author or topic, with filters for format, language, source, year and sort order

tools.name: article_search
tools.description: Find journal articles by keyword, author or year, or look one up by DOI

tools.name: metadata_search
tools.description: Search library catalogs such as Open Library, WorldCat and ISBNdb for editions and ISBNs

tools.name: book_details
tools.description: Show a search result's ISBNs and other identifiers, edition, description and reported file problems

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Show the membership and how many fast downloads are left

tools.name: book_download
tools.description: Download a book using the hash from a search result

tools.name: article_download
tools.description: Download an article by DOI or hash

secret_key.title: Secret key
secret_key.description: The secret key you log in to Anna's Archive with, from your account page. The server signs in with it and uses it for downloads.

download_path.title: Download folder
download_path.description: Where downloaded files are saved. The default, annas-archive in your home folder, needs no extra macOS permission.

account_cookie.title: Account cookie (optional)
account_cookie.description: Leave empty. Only needed if signing in with the secret key fails: the aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in browser.
